Minecraft Dungeons II Controller Mod (Windows)
==============================================

Plays the game with WASD, mouse and keys by turning them into a virtual
controller. The game itself isn't modified; the mod is one file
(xinput1_4.dll) next to the game's exe.

Install
-------
1. Close Minecraft Dungeons II.
2. Run "Dungeons II Controller Mod Setup.exe".
   Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" because the file isn't signed:
   click "More info", then "Run anyway".
3. It finds the game through Steam. If it doesn't, click Browse and pick
   Dungeons-Win64-Shipping.exe (in Dungeons\Binaries\Win64) or Dungeons.exe.
4. Click Install, then start the game.

In game: F9 shows the key list, the backtick key (`) turns the mod off and on,
T starts typing (Esc ends it).

Change keys
-----------
"Edit key layout..." opens the layout editor in your browser. Saving there
downloads wasdmod-MMDDYY.txt; click "Load layout file..." and pick it. Restart the
game afterwards. "Open settings file" opens the settings in Notepad.

Uninstall
---------
Run the setup again and click Uninstall. Steam's "Verify integrity" does not
remove the mod's files.

Notes
-----
- Built and tested on a Mac (CrossOver). Not yet tested on a Windows PC.
- Antivirus may flag the mod: it reads keys and presses controller buttons,
  which looks like other input tools.
- If install fails with a write error, run the setup as administrator.
